subject.title: chore(deps): bump the actions group across 1 directory with 14 updates

question: Should the 14-action group be accepted as one reviewed security-sensitive workflow update, or should the credential-bearing Codex, GitHub App token, and Docker action changes be split for narrower approval?
rationale: These revisions replace executable third-party action code in jobs holding sensitive credentials, and repository policy reserves the protected `security` item for explicit maintainer handling even though no concrete patch defect was found.

options.title: Approve the pinned group
options.body: Verify each upstream tag-to-SHA mapping and release note, then merge the rebased group after required workflow checks complete.

options.title: Split credentialed actions
options.body: Separate Codex, GitHub App token, and Docker login/build updates from setup and analysis actions to reduce review and rollback scope.

options.title: Pause for narrower Dependabot PRs
options.body: Close or supersede this grouped update only if maintainers prefer independently generated action updates with isolated CI evidence.

recommendation.title: Approve the pinned group
recommendation.body: Verify each upstream tag-to-SHA mapping and release note, then merge the rebased group after required workflow checks complete.

likelyOwner.reason: The strongest current-main history signal is ownership of credentialed Docker release workflows and their validation gates.
